name: Turkey Gravy
description: Pan gravy from turkey drippings and store-bought stock.

recipeInstructions.text: While the turkey roasts, you can simmer the reserved neck and giblets (not the liver) in chicken stock 30-60 minutes for more flavor, then strain. Otherwise just warm the stock.
Pour the pan drippings through a fat separator or into a bowl and skim off the fat, saving it.
In a saucepan over medium heat, melt 1/4 cup of the saved fat, topping up with butter if there isn't enough. Whisk in all-purpose flour and cook, whisking, until golden and nutty, 2-3 minutes.
Slowly whisk in the warm stock and the skimmed drippings. Simmer, whisking often, until thick enough to coat a spoon, 5-10 minutes.
Taste before seasoning; the drippings are salty from the brine. Add black pepper, a splash of apple cider to brighten, and salt only if it needs it.
